info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Unit Trust Administration API
info.description: The Unit Trust Administration API facilitates the management and retrieval of unit trust data for financial institutions. This endpoint allows authorized users to access current market operations related to unit trusts, including performance metrics and transaction histories. Typical consumers include fund managers and financial analysts who require up-to-date information for compliance and decision-making purposes. By utilizing this API, users can efficiently integrate unit trust administration functions into their applications.
